title: engine: snapshot deletes into the recycle bin, restore under original ids, purge, and the TTL reap (#3146 slice 3)
body:
triage#1 · os-zhuang · session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U

Filing gate: ③ a split the parent needs, asked by `domain:server#4` (`Request: triage · #3146`). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #30235
Part of #3146 · Ruling-ref: 6629858351 (the recycle-bin shape, maintainer 「同意，企业版功能在 cloud 中立卡后续开发」)

## Wanted

The engine half of the ruled v1:
- **Snapshot:** before a physical delete, write the rows it removes (the cascade set from `engine-delete-cascade.ts`) into one bin entry, then delete as today. Business objects only, not `sys_*`.
- **Restore:** write the rows back under their original ids, keep `created_by` / `created_at`, and restore a master-detail cascade together. Refuse with a reason, never a forced write, when a unique value is taken, the parent is purged, or the package is uninstalled. Re-link a `set_null` lookup only if nothing has changed it since. Emit a "restored" event, never a create. Rollups recompute.
- **Purge and TTL:** permanent delete never enters the bin. A TTL reap runs on the existing LifecycleService (the `sys_file` tombstone pattern).
- **Permissions:** a person restores what they deleted, and an admin sees all.

Every read path stays untouched.

**Order:** after #30235 (spec). The UI slice reads it.
